rules:
(lead 206 (2b); R3 threshold ASSUMED, line of sight not credited):
 R1  no Ti in a joint that clamps or is threaded into an N2O-wetted part or seal (CAD 'wetted' flag + hardware joint list)
 R2  no Ti in the head-top zone (bonnet rod seal, inlet, bleed tap and transducer ports vent there) or in the plume/nozzle zone
 R3  no Ti within D_R3 of any N2O-wetted part (TC-02 head counted whole: J-FWD / J-BON / port seals sit on it) at the neutral pose
 R4  strength-critical lines whose steel grade exceeds Ti-6Al-4V yield stay steel (12.9)

anti_galling_spec: Ti-6Al-4V screws anodised AMS 2488 Type 2 (anti-galling / anti-fretting); threads and head bearing face assembled with a PFPE-based thread lubricant (oxygen-compatible class, product TO-SELECT with datasheet) so one lubricant serves the whole engine; no graphite or MoS2 anti-seize; no helicoil (304) under a Ti screw (Ti/stainless galling) - HW-127/128 stay A4-70; torque re-derived from a torque-tension test on 3 samples per size (K of anodised + lubricated Ti TO-VERIFY); galvanic couple Ti/Al: Al parts anodised (as drawn), lubricant film, no bare Ti in salt fog storage
